title: Open Weights Are Not Open Source: Sovereign AI on Ethereum
description:
AI agents will inherit our messages, code, money and memory, yet their models are trained behind closed doors and controlled by a few providers. A provider may promise not to train on your data while still training models on knowledge derived from it. Release notes describe a model, but rarely make its training pipeline inspectable.

Sovereign AI starts from a stronger definition of openness: the training pipeline is part of the source. If a contribution lowers a model’s loss function, making it measurably less wrong, could the contributor earn a share of the model’s income? Could Ethereum coordinate funding, data and compute without putting one company in charge, while confidential computing protects private context and attestation verifies which model ran?

A DARPA-style challenge could bring teams together to make this loop work once, from training data to a private, verifiable answer, and discover what Ethereum builders still need to invent.
